{{Quote|They're growing healing herbs.''"<br />"''Nysillin, I believe, one of the most valuable crops in the galaxy.|Ahsoka Tano and Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=HealingHerbs-BH.flac|<ref name="BH" />}}
'''Akira''' was a farm established on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] to grow and harvest [[Nysillin/Legends|nysillin]], a healing herb that was highly valuable.

==History==
{{Quote|Nysillin farming is a meager trade. Without our herbs to sell, we will have no money for food, fuel or equipment.|Casiss|audio=NysillinFarming-BH.flac|<ref name="BH" />}}
[[File:Akira-BH.png|thumb|left|200px|The barn and homesteads of Akira protected by an [[energy fence]].]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Akira was tended by a group of [[Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] led by [[Casiss/Legends|Casiss]]. The farmers were threatened by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and his [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]] who wanted a cut of the profits from the highly valuable plant. To help them protect their livelihood, Casiss was forced to hire a group of four [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. The hunters included [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] and leader of the group, [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], a [[Kyuzo/Legends|Kyuzo]], [[Seripas/Legends|Seripas]], an alien who used a [[Seripas's armor/Legends|powerful mechanical suit]] to disguise his small stature, and [[Rumi Paramita/Legends|Rumi Paramita]], a female [[Frenk/Legends|Frenk]].<ref name="BH" />

After crash landing on Felucia, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] found their way to the farm in search of help and a way off the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. When told about the farmers' plight, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were sympathetic, but Kenobi, the ranking Jedi, said they were unable to help as their priority was to return to the Republic and make their report. Skywalker and Tano wanted to stay and help fight the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. They came to a compromise and began training the small farmers how to fight and defend themselves. The Jedi were forced to fight, however, when Ohnaka and his gang launched an assault on the farm. With the combined skill of the Jedi and bounty hunters and the determination of the farmers, they were able to repel the marauders and drive them off Felucia, with only minimal damage to the farm.<ref name="BH" />
